# Business Center ADGM — Aegis Coworking

> Aegis Coworking - ADGM runs a business centre on Level 38 of Addax Tower (Office 3812), Al Reem Island, RT3, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates — inside the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) jurisdiction. Serviced private offices start from AED 4,500 per month, dedicated desks AED 1,150, flexi desks AED 1,000 and virtual offices from AED 292. ADGM office leases are registered on AccessRP.

Focus: The company setup journey: choosing a workspace, KYC, AccessRP lease registration and using the address for an ADGM licence.

This site (businesscenteradgm.online) is a one-page guide to the Aegis business center in ADGM: serviced and private offices, desks, virtual office, meeting rooms, registered office and ADGM office leasing.

Last Updated: 2026-10-07

## Key facts

- Location: Level 38, Office 3812, Addax Tower, Al Reem Island — inside ADGM (24.4989303, 54.4031693)
- Private office (1–20+ people): from AED 4,500 per month; furnished, lockable, 24/7 access, ADGM registered office included
- Dedicated desk: AED 1,150 per month (one-time AED 1,200 due-diligence fee); ADGM registered office included
- Flexi desk (coworking): AED 1,000 per month; day pass AED 100
- Virtual office: from AED 292 per month (ADGM business address + mail handling)
- Meeting rooms and boardroom: hourly booking
- Leases 12–36 months, registered on AccessRP
- No deposit, no admin or setup fees, free registration; ADGM government fees separate
- FSRA-regulated firms usually need a private office
- Contact: +971 50 392 6316 · WhatsApp https://wa.me/971503926316 · contact@aegiscoworking.ae
- Tours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM; 24/7 access for office and desk members
